inline_early:
var calls:i64=0;inline fn make(early:bool)->i64[2]{defer{calls++;}if early{return[3,4];}return[7,8];}
fn main(){var a:i64[2]=make(true);var b:i64[2]=make(false);assert(a[1]==4);assert(b[1]==8);assert(calls==2);print("inline_early");}
declared_control:
var choice:bool=true;recursive fn select()->bool{choice=!choice;return choice;}
fn main(){var a:i64[2]=if select(){[3,4]}else{[7,8]};var b:i64[2]=if select(){[3,4]}else{[7,8]};assert(a[0]==7);assert(b[0]==3);print("declared_control");}
assigned_control:
var choice:bool=true;recursive fn select()->bool{choice=!choice;return choice;}
fn main(){var a:i64[2]=[1,2];a=if select(){[3,4]}else{[7,8]};assert(a[0]==7);a={let n=a[0];[n+1,n+2]};assert(a[0]==8);assert(a[1]==9);print("assigned_control");}
block_argument:
recursive fn read(a:i64[2])->i64{return a[1];}
fn main(){assert(read({let n:i64=7;[n,n+1]})==8);print("block_argument");}
empty_limited:
recursive fn make()->u8[..0]{return default<u8[..0]>();}
fn main(){var a:u8[..0]=make();assert(a.len==0);print("empty_limited");}
